name: default
text: Round B1 fitness (GDD 05 §5.4): F = result + 0.25 x speed (wins only) + 0.1 x margin + lambda x shaping. Shaping is the weighted mean of the strategic criteria, each weighted by base x the product of its gates, averaged over the run's turns. A gate is a piecewise-linear curve over one condition whose value changes at most once per hold_turns turns (hysteresis, B1Q6). Lambda anneals from 0.3 to 0 over 50 generations, or drops to 0 once the population beats the hall of fame more than 60% of the time (B1Q2).
